g.text: One data exchange, and where each threat sits
the sign-in, the request through the hub, the DSP negotiation and the DCP credential check, with the STRIDE ids
S-02 forged session, S-04 realm takeover
I-01 anonymous read, E-01 and E-02 wrong role, T-04 CSRF
D-01 and D-04 per-user and per-participant rate limit
R-01 and R-03 denied access or edited trail
I-02 management API exposed, E-04 token misuse
S-01 impersonated participant, T-02 terms changed in transit
S-03 replayed presentation, T-03 forged claim,
I-08 expired or revoked credential accepted
T-05 state jump, R-02 denied agreement
E-05 transfer without a contract, D-02 flood
Each note names the STRIDE ids of the table where that step is analysed. Steps in
the connectors are the EDC-V implementation's; the project tests them with the
DSP TCK, the DCP checks and the EHDS suites on every pull request.
